scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 17792 isolated CPU pairs for 62 pending functions of CGangWars, CGroupEventHandler, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Limits: LeaderEnterExit only with ProcessPed==true; fake peds, intelligences, matrices, vehicles and groups in own buffers with a fake ped/vehicle pool swapped (0xB74490/0xB74494) only during the call; tasks and events allocated in arenas filled with 0xCD (unwritten padding ignored; SetTask describes a clone of the task); returned allocations are NOT deleted with delete (the deleting destructor of the EXE, 0x69DB00, frees inline in the real pool 0xB744BC; only the destructor is called); CGangWars statics (0x96AB28..0x96ABD8), zones, population/streaming and clock 0xB7CB84 saved and restored. Collaborators doubled with trace (no credit): FindPlayerPed, SetTask, FindTaskByType, rand, LookAt, CEventGroup::Add, ComputeEventResponseTask, radar, stats, messages, population, save I/O.
